parameters.name: cluster_name
parameters.description: Cluster name; 2-20 characters using only letters, digits, and hyphens; must start with a letter and must not end with a hyphen

parameters.name: cluster_type_uuid
parameters.description: Cluster type UUID; currently must be ct-jn8sm0bejygcdglhpljbddjll9ro

parameters.name: vpc_uuid
parameters.description: VPC UUID; corresponds to vpcID in the VPC APIs

parameters.name: subnet_uuid
parameters.description: Subnet UUID; must belong to the selected VPC and corresponds to subnetID in the subnet APIs

examples: ctyun ehpc cluster create --cluster-name AB123456qw --cluster-type-uuid ct-jn8sm0bejygcdglhpljbddjll9ro --vpc-uuid 7cd6144c-50ec-4e07-afb7-6deab4f7931a --subnet-uuid dcdf90e1-34f6-4f73-8392-e72c4cffe3e9

parameters.name: cluster_uuid_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated cluster UUIDs; intersects with --cluster-name-list when both are set

parameters.name: cluster_name_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated cluster names; intersects with --cluster-uuid-list when both are set

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Page number; integer greater than or equal to 1

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Records per page in the range [1, 1000]

parameters.name: user_list
parameters.description: JSON array of [1, 100] users; each object requires userUUID and password; password must be 8-26 characters and contain a letter, a digit, and a special character from ~!@#$%^*_-+{[]}:,.?/

examples: ctyun ehpc user password update cl-zhqloubcsmycabomouuuwhgahwit --user-list '[{"userUUID":"us-0shvzkt5xpam4uctzvlqcde61snp","password":"WK5FRt~#"},{"userUUID":"us-h5d4tnbwoyntm1wylokawcvhfwkt","password":"WK4FRt~#"}]'
ctyun ehpc cluster delete cl-wkvfaqf2mqjcvhujdah0tq4oa8a4
ctyun ehpc cluster show cl-zhqloubcsmycabomouuuwhgahwit

parameters.name: node_name
parameters.description: Node name; must equal the instanceName of the backing bare-metal server

parameters.name: node_order_id
parameters.description: Completed bare-metal server order ID; the server must use the cluster VPC and an E-HPC image

parameters.name: node_role
parameters.description: Node role: 0 for master or 1 for compute

parameters.name: node_type
parameters.description: Node type; currently only 0 for bm bare metal is supported

examples: ctyun ehpc node create cl-3brxwcbjlorzcvaa6i1be1pv8v2c --node-name OpenAPI-master-001 --node-order-id ad74119d9b134dacbd8f051bf1deefbe --node-role 0 --node-type 0

parameters.name: node_name_list
parameters.description: JSON array of at most 99 node names; each name must equal instanceName for a server in the bare-metal order

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Page number; integer greater than or equal to 1

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Records per page in the range [1, 1000]

examples: ctyun ehpc node list cl-zhqloubcsmycabomouuuwhgahwit
ctyun ehpc node delete cl-n4oqobl9rpsciy9fkfeinjz8f0yi nd-1mafsl2d3nnqfpgxyqe5baa6s4s6
ctyun ehpc node show cl-zhqloubcsmycabomouuuwhgahwit nd-1mafsl2d3nnqfpgxyqe5baa6s4s6
